cycles.title: Exact Formula-Caching calculus, reason interface and cached-policy lower-bound route
cycles.result: C023 replaced Policy-0A's informal memo dictionary by the independently replayable JANUS-FC_local calculus, measured exact execution-DAG compression, separated Boolean residual reuse from generalized reason learning, falsified a proof-strength reading of the synthetic cache diamonds, and opened graph-tautology and MAJ3 routes for a cached-policy lower bound. No asymptotic Formula-Caching lower bound was obtained.
cycles.claim_boundary: C023 does not prove that JANUS-FC_local is stronger or weaker than Resolution, does not transfer the C022 lower bound to Policy-0A, and does not resolve P versus NP.
